entities.name: Bacterial flavohemoprotein Hmp
observations: 392-aa query is a strong full-length match to reviewed E. coli flavohemoproteins (~85.5% identity and 100% query coverage).
Homolog annotations support cytoplasmic nitric oxide dioxygenase activity: NO + O2 with NADH or NADPH is converted to nitrate, contributing to nitrosative-stress defense.
Reference homologs bind one heme b and one FAD per subunit; K-12 reference is annotated as monomeric. These are homology-based assignments for the query.
Sequence-derived estimates: 43,301.5 Da, pI 5.71, GRAVY -0.199; predicted domains include globin (27–130), FAD_binding_6 (158–252), and NAD_binding_1 (264–368).

entities.name: Nitric oxide detoxification
observations: Homolog evidence links Hmp nitric oxide dioxygenase activity to NO catabolism and bacterial response to nitrosative stress.
